Objective: Upgrade the MMORPG framework into a true emergent, self-consistent system by replacing placeholders with mathematically grounded simulation, relational graphs, and strict Watchdog enforcement aligned with A1–A5.

A1_Relational_Graph_Engine.Description: All entities exist as nodes in a weighted dynamic graph
A1_Relational_Graph_Engine.Code: class Graph { constructor(){ this.nodes=new Map(); this.edges=[];} addNode(n){this.nodes.set(n.id,n);} addEdge(e){this.edges.push(e);} getRelations(id){return this.edges.filter(e=>e.source===id||e.target===id);} computeValue(id){let rel=this.getRelations(id); return rel.reduce((sum,e)=>sum+e.weight,0);} }

A2_Historical_Recurrence_Engine.Description: All states influenced by weighted historical data
A2_Historical_Recurrence_Engine.Code: function computeState(history,lambda=0.1){ return history.reduce((sum,h)=> sum + h.value*Math.exp(-lambda*h.age),0); }

A3_Emergent_Interaction_Matrix.Description: System-wide interaction matrix generating non-linear outcomes
A3_Emergent_Interaction_Matrix.Code: function interact(matrix,state){ let result={}; Object.keys(state).forEach(a=>{ result[a]=0; Object.keys(state).forEach(b=>{ result[a]+=state[b]*matrix[a][b]; }); }); return result; }

A4_Watchdog_Constraint_Solver.Code: function watchdog(state){ if(state.value<0) state.value=0; if(state.value>MAX) state.value=normalize(state.value); if(!hasRelations(state)) reject(state); return state; }

A5_Continuous_Integration_Stream.Description: Real-time ingestion of all player/system events

Heuristic Wave Engine (Upgraded).Model: Weighted dynamic system instead of randomness
Heuristic Wave Engine (Upgraded).Code: function updateHeuristics(H,M,E){ let next=[]; for(let i=0;i<13;i++){ next[i]=0; for(let j=0;j<13;j++){ next[i]+=M[i][j]*H[j]; } next[i]+=E[i]||0;} return next; }
